title: What Is Your Greatest Weakness?
prompt:
Rewrite this answer to "What is your greatest weakness?" The candidate works in retail customer service (2 years of experience). Do NOT use clichés like "perfectionist" or "workaholic." Use this structure: name ONE real weakness, give a brief example of it at work, say what I am doing to improve it, and say what has changed so far. Keep the answer under 90 words, in first person. Do NOT invent numbers or facts — use [brackets] where a detail needs to be filled in.

My answer now: "I'm a perfectionist. I just care too much and work too hard."
example_output: Honestly, my weakness used to be not asking for help soon enough. If a customer case got complicated, I would try to solve it alone, and that sometimes made the customer wait longer than they should have. Now I check in with a teammate or my manager early, especially on [billing or returns cases outside my training]. I still own the case, but I escalate faster — so customers get the right answer sooner, and I'm learning how experienced staff handle the hard ones.
